users_phone_trio_check.name: users_phone_trio_check
users_phone_trio_check.value:
("users"."phone_number_encrypted" IS NULL) = ("users"."phone_number_hash" IS NULL)
          AND ("users"."phone_number_last4" IS NULL) = ("users"."phone_number_hash" IS NULL)

users_deleted_after_request_check.name: users_deleted_after_request_check
users_deleted_after_request_check.value: "users"."deleted_at" IS NULL OR "users"."deletion_requested_at" IS NOT NULL

users_completion_after_request_check.name: users_completion_after_request_check
users_completion_after_request_check.value: "users"."deletion_completed_at" IS NULL OR "users"."deletion_requested_at" IS NOT NULL

users_retention_after_request_check.name: users_retention_after_request_check
users_retention_after_request_check.value: "users"."retention_expires_at" IS NULL OR "users"."deletion_requested_at" IS NOT NULL

xor_constraint.name: xor_constraint
xor_constraint.value:
("purchase_options"."course_id" IS NOT NULL AND "purchase_options"."bundle_id" IS NULL) OR 
        ("purchase_options"."course_id" IS NULL AND "purchase_options"."bundle_id" IS NOT NULL)

xor_constraint.name: xor_constraint
xor_constraint.value:
("purchases"."course_id" IS NOT NULL AND "purchases"."bundle_id" IS NULL) OR 
        ("purchases"."course_id" IS NULL AND "purchases"."bundle_id" IS NOT NULL)

source_constraint.name: source_constraint
source_constraint.value:
("enrollments"."enrollmentSource" = 'bundle_purchase' AND "enrollments"."bundle_id" IS NOT NULL AND "enrollments"."purchase_id" IS NOT NULL) OR
        ("enrollments"."enrollmentSource" = 'purchase' AND "enrollments"."purchase_id" IS NOT NULL) OR
        ("enrollments"."enrollmentSource" IN ('free_access', 'admin_grant', 'preview'))
